d: Long, wavy charcoal-black hair with side-swept bangs and a yellow bow on the left side frames a youthful, adolescent face with wide, amber-gold eyes and a cheerful expression. The build is slender and petite, dressed in a white short-sleeved blouse under a sleeveless maroon jumper dress, accented by a large teal ribbon at the collar and a yellow strap over the shoulder. Visible accessories include white thigh-high stockings and heavy, grey mechanical naval weaponry equipped on the arms and back.
